text: The tool output confirms tree-cover loss of 0.6 hectares in 2022 within the native forest of this rural property. The evidence supports that this area was native forest (0.5 ha) and not planted forest. However, the tool does not establish whether this loss violated forest protection rules. It cannot determine legality, compliance with regulations, or the cause of the loss (e.g., legal harvesting vs. illegal clearing). Further investigation would be needed to assess compliance with forest protection rules.
